title.narrative: HCFC Phase Out Management Plan - Kuwait (stage II)

description.narrative: Kuwait#s HPMP Stage#II (2019#2026) aims to deliver a 67.5#% reduction in HCFC consumption by 2025 through strengthened HCFC licensing/quota systems, expanding e#licensing and customs training, certifying and upskilling over 1,700 refrigeration service technicians, and establishing a second national HCFC recovery, recycling, and reclamation center.
